name: Rouergue Creation Top Notice Bar
author: Rouergue Création

sections.description:
Rouergue Creation Top Notice Bar allows you to display a clean, lightweight, and customizable
notice bar at the top of your WordPress site.

The plugin provides a modern React-based settings page, built with official WordPress
components, making it easy to configure the content, appearance, visibility, and scheduling of the notice bar.

✅ Compatible with classic themes and block themes
✅ No shortcode required
✅ Fully compatible with fixed and sticky headers

Settings Page

After activating the plugin, a RCTNB Settings page is available in the WordPress admin area.
This page allows you to configure:

Content & Behavior

  • Message displayed at the top of the site(Use plain text or HTML in your message)
  • Enable or disable the notice bar
  • Optional scrolling text (right to left)
  • Adjust the scrolling speed based on message length
  • Enable a fixed position for the notice bar
  • Option to hide the notification bar on mobile(≤ 480px)
  • Enable a call-to-action button
  • Open the call-to-action link in a new tab
  • Enable close button
  • Enable a cookie when closing the notification bar

Appearance

  • Text size
  • Text, background, and button colors

Scheduling

  • Enable scheduling for the notice bar
  • Define a start date and time
  • Define an end date and time
  • The notification bar will only appear automatically during the selected time and date range
  • Uses the WordPress site timezone settings

Visibility

  • Choose how the notice bar visibility is handled
  • Exclude the notice bar from selected publications
  • Or display the notice bar only on selected publications
  • Multiple selection supported (posts, pages, and custom post types)

  • No manual ID input required

  • User targeting options:

    • Public: display the notice bar to all visitors
    • Connected users only: display the notice bar only to logged-in users
    • User roles: display the notice bar only for selected user roles
    • Specific user accounts: display the notice bar only for selected users

👉 Once enabled and configured, the notice bar is automatically displayed
at the top of your site.

Theme Compatibility

The plugin is compatible with:

  • Classic themes
  • Block themes
  • Themes using static or fixed headers

The notice bar relies on the WordPress core wp_body_open hook to be displayed correctly.

If a theme (or child theme) does not include this hook, the notice bar will not appear.

Fixed Header Compatibility

If your theme uses a fixed or sticky header, the notification bar must also be enabled in fixed position in order to be displayed correctly.
The header is dynamically repositioned below the notification bar.
The page content is adjusted to prevent overlap.
The WordPress admin bar (when present) is fully taken into account.

ADD

  • Scheduling feature to control when the notice bar is displayed

  • Start and end date/time configuration

  • User targeting options in the Visibility section:

    • Public visibility
    • Logged-in users only

    • Visibility by specific user accounts

MODIFIED
